Hopewell Carter
Preserved Primary Document • carty-h.htm
Photo Courtesy of  John Carter
Hopewell Umphrey Carter, son of  Elizabeth Carty , was born in Maryland on 28 		January,
1857
. It is believed that he was the son of Dr. Alexander Hardcastle, a Caroline County neighbor of the 	Carty family.
On 25 December,
1888
he married Sarah Catherine RIDGEWAY.
Hopewell and Sarah had the following children:
John W. Carter married Nora (last name unknown)
Alice Carter
Agnes Carter married Aubrey Newlin
Catherine Carter
Laura Carter
Hopewell Carter
married  Lethia Coker
Hopewell Sr. died on 13 February,
1933
. He is buried with his wife Sarah, who died in
1938
, at Immanuel Union 		(Manship) Church in Cheswold, DE.

It is believed that he was the son of Dr. Alexander Hardcastle, a Caroline County neighbor of the Carty family. On 25 December, 1888 he married Sarah Catherine RIDGEWAY. Hopewell and Sarah had the following children: John W. Carter married Nora (last name unknown) Alice Carter Agnes Carter married Aubrey Newlin Catherine Carter Laura Carter Hopewell Carter married Lethia Coker Hopewell Sr. died on 13 February, 1933. He is buried with his wife Sarah, who died in 1938, at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold, DE. photo curtesy of John Carter photo curtesy of John Carter
